title:
Represents a group of homogenous Virtual Machines (VMs) that can be consumed by {@link CloudCluster.Node}
There should at least exist one CloudCluster.NodePool for a given CloudCluster.
Each CloudCluster.NodePool is characterized by the following:
     1. {@link CloudProvider}: Specifies where a CloudCluster.NodePool exists (ex: K8s, Gcp, Aws, or Azure)
     2. {@link CloudCluster.NodePool.Config}: Describes a CloudCluster.NodePool's allocatable resources and unique hardware
This type is primarily used for specifying C3-application usage constraints and should not be confused with
{@link App.NodePool}, which represents a group of C3 nodes
name: CloudCluster.NodePool
